description: This file contains utility functions for opening files in a robust manner within the Git codebase. It includes a retry mechanism for interrupted open calls and a fallback to set close-on-exec flags if supported by the kernel.

methods.name: int git_open_with_retry(const char * path,int flags,...)
methods.description: Attempts to open a file with retry on EINTR signal, supports variable argument for mode when creating files.

methods.name: int git_open_cloexec(const char * name,int flags)
methods.description: Opens a file descriptor with close-on-exec flag set, with fallback for kernels that do not support O_CLOEXEC.
